observations: Photo 0 shows a wall-mounted/standing-style rechargeable fan with a circular grille and 3-blade fan head.
Photo 0 shows a black battery/charging unit attached to the fan arm with a cable/charger area visible.
Photo 1 shows a close view of the fan head and grille; the center hub has a logo/mark that is not fully readable.
No clear brand/model text is readable from the photos; no label showing battery capacity or runtime is visible.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Brand name 'Qasa' is not clearly readable in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show battery capacity, runtime test, or a charge indicator.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Photos show no clear purchase date/receipt; wear level is not enough to confirm 'barely used'.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm internal motor condition or whether it was opened.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Battery runtime may be much shorter than claimed (battery degradation).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: fully charge the fan, then show the fan running on high for a timed duration (e.g., 30–60 minutes) with the charge indicator visible if any.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven to meet 'up to 2 hours' (worst case: treat as average/weak runtime).

risks.risk: Fan may have performance issues (noise, wobble, weak airflow) not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip starting from off to running on high and low, filmed from the front showing airflow and any unusual noise (audio included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service/with reduced performance.

risks.risk: Recharge/charging system may be faulty or missing parts (charger/cable/battery pack health).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the exact charger/cable and battery pack label (if present), plus a clip showing charging in progress (indicator/light).
risks.if_unproven: Price as charger/battery not guaranteed (worst case: treat as battery health uncertain).

risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the brand/model label on the hub or battery unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic rechargeable standing fan.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model label on the fan hub and/or battery unit (so we can confirm 'Qasa' and exact model).
Timed video: fully charged runtime test on high (and optionally low), with any charge indicator visible.
Video clip showing start-up and operation on high and low (include audio for noise/wobble).
Photos of the receipt and warranty card (or at least the warranty card details), plus a photo of the charger/cable and any battery label.
response.reason: The photos show a rechargeable standing fan, but the key details that determine price (exact brand/model and verified battery runtime/working condition) are not provable from the images alone.
